run_trf011_lint: run the TRF011 lint check on a transformers model file to detect unsafe PP-managed submodule attribute access in forward methods
check_forward_pp_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF011 violations where forward() accesses non-nn.Module attributes on pipeline-parallel submodules
collect_pp_modules_for_model: collect pipeline-parallel managed module names from base_model_pp_plan assignments in a transformers configuration file
build_pp_modules_index: build a mapping of model directories to their pipeline-parallel managed top-level module names from configuration files
detect_unsafe_submodule_access: detect unsafe attribute access on pipeline-parallel submodules like self.<module>.<attr> where attr is not a standard nn.Module attribute
